oldActual31_100Seconds: Observed whole-method elapsed time, not an execution deadline.
boundedStringQualification: UTF-8 prefix decoding can replace a split scalar; original lengths/prefix lengths/truncation flags are explicit and the final encoded line cap includes that replacement. Detail reduction/encoding failures are reported as such.
callbackQualification: Stored progress is a last observed callback, not a fresh or atomic engine snapshot. Existing task-local observers are forwarded. Observation can perturb timing; no wait budget is widened.
resultQualification: Only the already-returned result or error is summarized. No task join/read, engine stop/retry, extra polling, filesystem walk or stdout/stderr content read is added by the observer.
privacy: Generated JavaScript/source maps and error descriptions are represented only by lengths/SHA256; no source, environment, token or complete output is printed. Bounded compiler diagnostic messages belong to the fixed original synthetic test source.
optionalExitCode: For a present execution result, emit exitCodePresent explicitly and only serialize an unwrapped Int exitCode when present; never coerce Optional to Any or pass it to String(_:).
